technique_name: Generate a description of a facial recognition system.
description: Facial recognition systems are computer-based algorithms that utilize mathematical and statistical techniques to identify and categorize faces based on characteristics such as features, texture, and shape. The system can process digital images or video files of people’s faces, and compare them against a database of faces.
